title: OKX Sign Up Referral Code: Where to Enter It, Step by Step

thumbnail.image_prompt: a person filling a sign-up form on a laptop at a bright desk, phone beside the keyboard, clean modern workspace

scenes.title: OKX sign up referral code
scenes.sub: The exact moment to type it

alt: hands on laptop keyboard bright desk
media.image_prompt: hands typing on a laptop at a bright modern desk with a smartphone beside it, soft daylight

lines.show: You enter an OKX referral code on the first sign-up screen, in the field for a referral or invite code, before you finish registration.
It works the same in the app and on the website.
Let's walk through both, then cover the small mistakes that make the code fail.
Here's the app route.
Install OKX from your phone's official app store.
Open it and tap Sign up.
Enter your email address or phone number.
On the same screen, look for the referral code field. It may be folded under an optional line, so tap to open it.
Then create a strong password and confirm the code sent to you.

scenes.title: Optional means easy to miss
scenes.text: Open the field before you continue.

lines.show: The word optional is the trap here.
Many people tap continue without opening the field, and the chance to add a code is gone.
Prefer a computer? The website works too.
Type the OKX address yourself in the browser, instead of clicking an ad or a link from a message.
Click Sign up.
Add your email or phone number.
Then open the referral code field and type the code before you continue.

scenes.title: Look-alike sites exist
scenes.text: Check the address bar every time.

lines.show: Fake sites can copy the look of a real exchange.
Check the address bar before you type any password.

scenes.title: Three common mistakes
items: A zero instead of an O

lines.show: When a code doesn't work, it's usually one of these.
A space copied before or after the code.
A number zero typed instead of the letter O.
Or the account was already created before the code was added.

scenes.title: Then read the rewards page
scenes.text: Offers and terms live in the app.

lines.show: Once you're in, open the rewards page.
New user offers change and can differ by country, so the terms there are what counts.

media.stock: typing on phone keyboard close up

lines.show: The code for this channel is XOACPQFC.
It's letters only, with no spaces and no zeros.

scenes.title: If OKX is available where you live
scenes.text: Type the code when you sign up

media.stock: laptop and phone on desk evening

lines.show: If OKX is available where you live, open the referral field and type XOACPQFC during sign-up.
Thanks for watching.
